scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.kill: powershell -Command "$p5000 = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p5000) { Stop-Process -Id $p5000.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Host 'Freed port 5000.' }; $p3000 = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p3000) { Stop-Process -Id $p3000.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Host 'Freed port 3000.' }"
